notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only date is the 1930s, and no source describes the abandonment, staffing, or any remains. The brief's status 'gone' and kind 'platform' are not supported; the sources say abandoned, and the FFLA list types it Crowsnest. An Idaho Fire Lookouts category page carries an excerpt 'burnt down the same year it was built in 1931', but the listing does not tie it to Packsack Point, so it is not used. Access is undocumented beyond the hike-in label. The story is about 103 words, under the 120-word floor, because the four pages give little beyond these facts; nothing was padded.
